title: Trillanes remains part of House prosecution's witness list — Ridon
summary: Former Senator Antonio Trillanes remains part of the House prosecution's witness list in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, according to House Impeachment Prosecutor Terry Ridon.
